text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: ...? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back to the academy after an 
outside interview, 
Phalaenopsis stopped in front of a 
bookstore.
choice_data_list: ……？どうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: ...? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, there is nothing I wish to buy... 
merely something I must check. Would you 
mind waiting a moment?
choice_data_list: 何か買いたいものがあるなら、付き合うよ？
choice_data_list_en: If there's something you want to buy, I'll go with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stepping into the bookstore with her, I 
saw it— 
a special feature centered on the recent 
Japan Cup 
and "those girls" of her generation.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Have you not noticed an increase in 
articles 
about them in magazines and online as of 
late?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Discussions surrounding this year's Japan 
Cup... 
and, by extension, my contemporaries.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I see them all the time.
Yeah, I see them a lot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by El Condor Pasa and Special Week... 
as well as names like Grass Wonder 
and Seiun Sky mentioned throughout the 
press.
choice_data_list: ああ、よく見るよ
うん、よく見るよ
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I see it often.
Yeah, I see it all the time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The exploits of Phalaenopsis's peers, who 
had taken 
the racing world by storm along the 
Classic Triple Crown route, 
were frequently highlighted across all 
media.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Their brilliance is so magnificent it 
nearly dazzles the eyes.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
My contemporaries adorn the racing world 
of today 
with a radiance akin to pure gold...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You must have witnessed it yourself during 
the Japan Cup. 
The races they weave... stir the blood so 
fiercely.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And it is no wonder... Each possesses such 
formidable individuality, 
and whenever they share the same stage, 
they scatter grand, breathtaking sparks.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
With every race, victory is anyone's to 
claim. 
With every race, anyone's triumph thrills 
the soul.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...In doing so, they have drawn the 
world's eye to their generation. 
And the culmination of that is the 
feverish excitement before us.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: This is precisely what I lack.
choice_data_list: What you lack...? Do you really think so?
What you lack...? Is that really true?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words bring back memories of the scene 
at the club we visited just the other day—
choice_data_list: 足らないものって……そう、なのか？
足らないものって……そう、なの？
choice_data_list_en: What's missing... Is that really what it is?
What's missing... Is that really what it is?

text_block_list.name: Female Club Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Phalaeno-san! 
We've got even more new members joining! 
Please come show your faces!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Her victory at the Shuka Sho had made the 
club livelier than ever. 
With her juniors growing in number, 
she was steadily approaching her dream.
choice_data_list:
I really don't think you need to rush, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —No. It is not enough.
choice_data_list: 何も、焦る必要はないと思うけど
choice_data_list_en: I don't think there's any need to rush, though.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
More... I require far more. A future where 
young fillies race the garden 
and our sisters bring home GⅠ victories— 
to achieve that, we need far more hands.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
One might call it 'attention.' I must 
captivate 
the eyes and ears of the audience far more 
completely.
choice_data_list: ...May I ask what makes you feel that way?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...The Japan Cup made me keenly aware. 
The brilliance they emanate is simply too 
dazzling.
choice_data_list: …………そう思う理由を聞いてもいい？
choice_data_list_en: …………Can I ask why you think so?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is not that the light everyone polished 
within me is dim. 
It simply has not reached their 
incandescent brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
To close that distance, I must devote 
myself further.
choice_data_list: I see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired by her contemporaries' success, 
she took a stoic measure 
of where she stood, and I couldn't help 
but admire her.
choice_data_list: なるほど……
choice_data_list_en: I see...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The truth was that she had already 
accomplished plenty— 
and yet, it was precisely this drive to 
improve 
that had allowed her to produce results up 
to this day.
choice_data_list:
Let's figure out a way to draw attention 
together.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Yes. I place myself in your care.
choice_data_list: 注目を集める方法、一緒に模索していこう
choice_data_list_en: Let's work together to figure out how to grab the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Yet, how specifically should I go 
about it? 
By clashing their fighting spirits against 
one another, 
they have created a grand wave across 
their entire generation.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Do I, too, require... a rival? 
To hone myself against them and draw the 
world's eye... 
Must I devise such a strategy?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? 
Is that—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. 
It seems my encouragement bore some fruit 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us see. 
Just how much your edge has dulled—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ngh... HAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Her former brilliance is no longer there. 
The running 
I so admired... the fierce power of her 
prime has been lost.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... why? 
Why does her stride hold such burning 
heat—?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A flame that scorches my soul... is still 
there.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ......Ah, of course.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It matters not if she has waned. 
—So long as she remains the Hungry Wolf.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(This is the sight that seared itself into 
my heart. 
This figure, endlessly pouring her raw 
passion into the turf. 
That is why, even now—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Brian's running has true splendor.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: This is what I yearned for.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Once more, 
I have discerned the true ambition I must 
fulfill.
choice_data_list: ...Will you tell me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Becoming a raging inferno like 
Brian, 
I shall confront those on the Classic 
route.
choice_data_list: ……聞かせてくれる？
choice_data_list_en: ...Will you tell me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
She devoted herself entirely to pouring 
her flame into the race 
and drew in the spectators. Her fervor 
swept everyone into frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Truly a 'peerless bloom' of this era. 
A champion capable of seizing both frenzy 
and glory alone—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: And that is what I shall become.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thus, for my next race, I wish to aim for 
the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list: ......Wait, what?! The Arima?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I am well aware this is reckless. 
I know how little time remains. And yet—
choice_data_list_en: …………Huh!? The Arima!?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my grand ambition, I must 
stack achievements relentlessly. 
The Arima is merely my stepping stone.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I will keep my sights on the Tiara. On top 
of that, 
the Japan Cup, the Tenno Sho (Spring)... 
I shall challenge every G1 that catches my 
eye.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Will you grant me your permission, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: (......Something feels off.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To model herself after Narita Brian 
and become the 'peerless bloom of this 
era.' 
There was nothing wrong with that goal, 
but...
choice_data_list: （…………何か、おかしい）
choice_data_list_en: (......Something's off.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We had once agreed to pursue the Tiara 
route 
to attract successors to the club. 
Just the two of us, together with her 
Trainer.
choice_data_list: （そのための手段が、あまりにも短絡的だ）
choice_data_list_en: (The means to that end are far too short-sighted.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet out of nowhere, without consulting me 
at all, 
she suddenly announced she wanted to head 
for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...If she was simply following in Narita 
Brian's footsteps, 
it might not be an entirely baseless 
choice. But—
choice_data_list: I don't think this is like you.
I don't believe this is like you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Not like me? What do you mean by that?
choice_data_list: 君らしくないと思う
貴方らしくないと思う
choice_data_list_en: I don't think that's like you.
I don't think that's like you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: My focus...? Me?
choice_data_list: 目標を散らしてしまっている
choice_data_list_en: Our focus is too scattered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of Phalaenopsis's greatest strengths 
was her razor-sharp sense of purpose.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running the Tiara to repay her debt to the 
club. 
It was that unwavering, keen gaze, fixed 
solely on that goal, 
which served as her greatest weapon.
choice_data_list: And right now, that edge has dulled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Run the Tiara. Claim the Arima as well. 
Challenge every G1 that crosses her 
vision. 
The words she spoke were bold, but—
choice_data_list: それが、今は“鈍ってる”
choice_data_list_en: Except right now, that's 'dulled'.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: 蛮勇に聞こえる
choice_data_list_en: Sounds like sheer recklessness to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Phalaenopsis was never thoughtless. 
She was someone who surveyed the future 
before leaping, 
yet right now, that discerning vision 
seemed clouded.
choice_data_list:
Let's reconsider whether heading to the 
Arima is truly the right path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our true purpose was always the prosperity 
of the club... 
Which was why we chose the Tiara route 
to pave the path for future generations.
choice_data_list: 改めて、『有馬』に向かうべきかは考えよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's rethink whether we should really aim for Arima.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...If she recklessly took on everything, 
her preparations 
for the Tiara route risked being 
neglected. 
I wanted to avoid that at all costs.
choice_data_list:
Because you're the horsegirl who has shone 
on the Tiara path.

Because you are the horsegirl who has 
shone on the Tiara path.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: That... is true.
choice_data_list: 君は、ティアラで輝いてきたウマ娘だから
貴方は、ティアラで輝いてきたウマ娘だから
choice_data_list_en: Because you're an Umamusume who's shone in the Tiara races.
Because you're an Umamusume who has shone in the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking on races like the Arima Kinen in 
the future would be fine. 
However, doing so after seeing the Tiara 
route through 
would by no means be too late.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This, too, was the faith I had in her. 
If it was Phalaenopsis, even without 
rushing into it now— 
she was bound to seize victory in due 
time.
choice_data_list: So I don't think you need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: だから、慌てなくてもいいと思うよ
choice_data_list_en: So, I don't think there's any need to panic.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I understand.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: For now, I shall defer to your judgment.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Rebuffed, was I?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(I cannot deny there is doubt in my heart. 
Yet... is it truly all right to remain as 
I am...?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is not enough. ...As things stand, it 
is simply not enough. 
Therefore, something... must change...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I will not settle. Never.
